Create a greenhouse maintenance scenario in Goal DSL using a Redis Broker on localhost at port 6379.

Define two entities:

A sensor entity named ClimateSensor at the URI greenhouse.sensors.humidity which has a float attribute for humidity.

A hybrid entity named WaterBot at the URI greenhouse.robot.actuator with float attributes for waterLevel and battery, and a dictionary attribute for position.

Define the following goals:

An EntityStateCondition goal named CheckBattery to ensure the WaterBot battery is above 20.0.

An EntityStateCondition goal named CheckHumidity to check if the ClimateSensor humidity is below 40.0.

A Position goal named MoveToRefillStation for the WaterBot to reach Point2D(5.0, 5.0) with a maximum deviation of 0.5.

An EntityStateCondition goal named CheckWaterLevel to verify the WaterBot waterLevel is above 90.0.

A Position goal named MoveToPlant for the WaterBot to reach Point2D(10.0, 10.0) with a maximum deviation of 0.5.

Group these goals into a Complex goal named WaterPlants. Use the all accomplished ordered strategy to ensure the goals are performed sequentially. Add a time constraint requiring the goal to be finished within 600 seconds from the goal start.

Finally, create a Scenario named GreenhouseMaintenance that executes the WaterPlants goal.
